name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
blurb: A towering, colourful temple complex at the heart of Madurai, famous for its gopurams and sculpted halls.

name: Brihadisvara Temple
blurb: A Chola-era UNESCO World Heritage temple known for its massive granite vimana.

name: Shore Temple
blurb: Stone temple on the Bay of Bengal coast, part of the Group of Monuments at Mahabalipuram.

name: Marina Beach
blurb: One of the longest urban beaches in India, best enjoyed in the cool evening hours.

name: Kanyakumari
blurb: The southern tip of the mainland, where three seas meet and sunrise and sunset views draw crowds.

name: Ooty
blurb: A classic hill station with tea gardens, a botanical garden and the Nilgiri mountain railway.

name: Kodaikanal
blurb: Misty hills, a star-shaped lake and viewpoints over the Palani range.

name: Yercaud
blurb: A quieter, budget-friendly hill station in the Shevaroy hills with coffee plantations.

name: Hogenakkal Falls
blurb: Cascades on the Kaveri river, known for coracle rides when the water level is safe.

name: Courtallam Falls
blurb: A cluster of waterfalls popular during the southwest monsoon season.

name: Mudumalai National Park
blurb: Tiger reserve and elephant habitat in the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve.

name: Valparai
blurb: Tea and coffee estates on the Anamalai hills, reached by a scenic hairpin-bend road.

name: Rameswaram
blurb: Island pilgrimage town with the Ramanathaswamy Temple, reached over the Pamban bridge.

name: Pichavaram Mangrove Forest
blurb: One of the largest mangrove forests in India, explored by boat through narrow channels.
